mathematicalInvariants.formalDefinition: SUM(all transaction line spend INR) == TOTAL_SPEND_INR
All downstream calculations consume unrounded 64-bit float values.
Every transaction has exactly one inclusion status: VALID, EXCLUDED, ANOMALY, or REQUIRES_REVIEW.
Every excluded transaction has a recorded non-empty exclusion reason.
Every financial metric resolves to underlying transaction IDs and source rows.
No transaction is counted more than once in any aggregation partition.
